nodes.title:
WhatsApp feeds memory through the same gates as a call. memory.extract_thread {threadId} (system actor; the channels module calls it when a thread goes quiet or its 24-hour window ends) reads the thread's messages since a per-thread cursor (memory_thread_cursor).
- Inbound person messages are the person's lines; outbound messages (her, templates, team members) are not.
- A quote must be an exact substring of ONE inbound message, and the fact keeps span {messageId, start, end}.
- The gates are the call's: refused categories, basis, purpose (the connection's agent), personal agreement, undo or review.
- The forget phrases apply too: keep nothing, or forget the person now.
- Only a verified sender (channel_thread.contact_id) is ever remembered; an opted-out thread (STOP, or a WhatsApp withdrawal in consent_record) never is.
- Facts are marked channel 'whatsapp' and live only in the tenant's rows; no pooled path reads memory (Meta s.4.7).
- storeFacts is the one write path for calls and threads.
- The model is asked outside the transaction; a changed thread commits nothing; a failed run keeps the cursor.
nodes.rationale: The integrator asked for the seam for the channels builder: one contact timeline, one memory, the same exact-quote and span rule.
nodes.reverse_if: Threads need memory while the conversation is still going (not after it goes quiet): then extract per inbound message with a short debounce. Or Meta's terms change on using message content for AI features: then switch the channel off by default per workspace.

nodes.title:
tests/memory-whatsapp.test.ts 4/4:
(1) An inbound message proposes 'shaam 6 baje ke baad'. It is stored with channel 'whatsapp', its message id and the exact span. Her words and a paraphrase are dropped (2). The model sees PERSON and BUSINESS lines, and the next call's brief carries it.
(2) The cursor: a second run with nothing new is 'no_new_messages' with 0 model calls; a new message is read alone, and old ones are not resent.
(3) A sender not on file gets 'sender_not_verified' with 0 model calls; a WhatsApp withdrawal gives 'whatsapp_opted_out'. A health fact is refused and a relocation without agreement is dropped. 'Mere baare mein kuch yaad mat rakhna' forgets them (requested_via 'whatsapp') with 0 model calls.
(4) A member actor and another workspace are refused, and the facts stay in the tenant.
nodes.method: node:test on throwaway Postgres 16 (NODE_ENV=test), channel fixtures in SQL, scripted model

events.details: memory.extract_thread: WhatsApp messages propose facts through the call's gates (exact quote within one inbound message, span, verified sender only, never opted out, cursor), with storeFacts shared with calls; migration 0705. Verified: tests/memory-whatsapp.test.ts 4/4 plus memory suites and the gates. Not verified: the channels module calling it (its trigger is theirs to wire), and real WhatsApp text (emoji, voice-note transcripts).
